decisions.summary: trees_overlap keeps every canopy-over-X test; its pair test reports only a duplicated tree (trunks closer than a third of the smaller crown's radius, a labeled GUESS); the test rewritten: a partly overlapping pair passes, a concentric pair is reported
decisions.why: The GM: crowns may overlap; the rule was against trees 'overlapping in ways which didn't make sense'. FR-001 lets crowns overlap, keeps the duplicated-tree finding and requires its threshold sourced or labeled a guess; D1 labels it a guess (R2 records the absence) and it catches feature 257's concentric pair. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: Phase 1 now reads 'T01: trees_overlap drops the crown-on-crown test; its pair test reports only a duplicated tree (the test rewritten red first); docs.'
decisions.why: Round 1's wording item applied: the phase line now matches D1 and FR-001 (the crown-on-crown test dropped, the duplicated-tree finding kept, the test rewritten not deleted). No implementer reading it literally would remove the duplicated-tree check.

decisions.summary: The grove's crowns overlap: placement accepts a center at least about half the two radii from every other; target a closed canopy measured on the layout and reported in the notes; degree labeled a guess
decisions.why: FR-002/SC-002: the canopy covers most of the grove's ground, measured on the layout, sheet and map matching. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: The hall-and-dwelling 72 by 32 ft (2,304 sq ft): hall 28 by 32 centered on the approach axis, kitchen and dwelling ends 22 ft each; interior refitted
decisions.why: The GM: size the shrine from the research, not the 60 by 48 ft glyph. FR-003's three bands hold on the plan's arithmetic (hall end 28/32 in 20-35 ft; 2,304 in 2,100-3,600 sq ft; 32 ft = 9.75 m in 8-13 m). Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: The map follows the sheet: glyph 36 by 16 map px at the same center; manifest records to it; arches one pitch off the new face; grove's far edge at the outermost arch; frozen map edited by hand as in 268
decisions.why: FR-003 requires the map's glyph and manifest brought to the new footprint with arches, forecourt, basin, clearing and grove following. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: The sizing rule: a building's dimensions on a sheet come from the research unless the GM gave them, and never from a map's glyph as a measurement; where a map's glyph differs, the map is edited to the sheet
decisions.why: Now carries FR-004's wording verbatim ('never ... from a map's glyph as a measurement'), from the GM's 'presume they are NOT a real measurement as a default'. The second half generalizes what FR-003 does for this building and is forced by feature 257's matches_map. It widens nothing the GM limited and narrows nothing asked.
